purpose.domain_detail: Japanese national health insurance claim (receipt/seikyu) processing — monthly aggregation and printing of insurance billing claims (kokuho/seikyu-sho) for a medical clinic
purpose.summary: SOKATU0710 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system that processes and prints monthly national health insurance claim summaries (sokuatsu/seikyu-sho). It reads a temporary indexed claim file, updates a receipt DB update file, handles error files, and produces printed output via subprogram calls. It supports multiple insurance types and handles special cases such as retirement insurance and public expense billing.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (31 copybooks) for JMA ORCA shared layouts
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM for shell invocation
UNSTRING on COMMAND-PARAM for argument parsing
LINE SEQUENTIAL files for update and error output
OCCURS table for city-number conversion (WRK-CITYNUM-TBL OCCURS 20)
REDEFINES used for hospital name/address splitting
High comment ratio (~40%) with Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments
Version history embedded in comments (01.00.01 through 01.00.07)
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese (garbled in latin-1 view). This is a well-known open-source Japanese medical system (JMA ORCA). The 107KB file with 2505 lines, 31 COPY statements, 61 CALLs, and detailed version history strongly indicates production-grade code.
